Name: (AT) Lots of Rock Crabs
Author: Campaigner
Description:
APRIL 2026 UPDATE:
- Version 1.1 released

[b](AT) Lots of Rock Crabs[/b]

Do you like crabs, but don't like fishing? Wish you could have a crawling crustacean on your farm? Maybe more than one? Maybe... over a hundred? Two hundred? ... FOUR hundred? [size=1]And I thought I was crazy![/size]

Making use of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] mod by PeacefulEnd, you can do just that! Go buy a turtle from Marnie, or use the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24188]Enable Turtle[/url] by alichanST to start with one on a fresh save, and buy the scissors item from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] from Robin. Find your turtle, and snip snip snip! You'll be shown a menu that is absolutely overloaded with rock crabs! Find the look you want, select it, and lament as you now realize you need more turtles to have more crabs! Marnie is going to be rich thanks to your newfound love of crabs! [size=1]No, this mod is not sponsored by Marnie. Don't believe the lies.[/size]

There are twelve variants of rock crabs, each one sporting a numerous amount of shell options. The first six rock crabs use the vanilla design and colors of the exposed rock crabs (from breaking their shells, you monster), while the second six are actual crabs that utilize a mixture of custom and vanilla sprites with the color schemes of the vanilla rock crabs. All twelve variants have every shell variant, so there's an incredibly amount of customization available here!


[b]Other Mod Requirements:[/b]
This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures by PeacefulEnd[/url]﻿, considering there's no way to select from all these textures otherwise.
[s]Not required, but I suggest grabbing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24188]Enable Turtle by  alichanST[/url]﻿ if you want to start with a turtle to make early use of my textures.[/s] [size=1]This mod is no longer available :([/size]

[b]You have permission to: [/b]
- Use these textures for your own personal or public mods as long as you just link back to this mod
- Enjoy crabs. It is mandatory to enjoy crabs.

[b]You do not have permission to:[/b]
- Use these textures for your own personal or public mods without linking back here. That would make me sad. You don't want that, right?
- NOT enjoy crabs. It is mandatory to enjoy crabs.
